rina.onboard: hi all  day 2 q: who do I ping for a quick map of ownerships? specifically: (1) who owns feature-flag infra, (2) who approves short-lived test DB creds, and (3) who to cc when an experiment spikes errors in staging?
sam-plat: welcome @rina.onboard! feature-flag infra = platform/flags team (cc @sam-plat). for short-lived creds open an INFRA-ACCESS ticket and request role `db_test_ro` with ttl=8h.
jules-sre: for staging spikes create an incident channel with /incident create and tag SRE. If it's experiment-related, also ping product/owner and platform lead. escalation: owner -> oncall SRE -> platform lead.
tara-devex: quick tip: for experiments we often request a scoped flag and a sandbox DB. If you DM me the experiment id i can spin up sandbox copies and a test flag (ttl 24h).
infra-queue-bot: Reminder: Access requests require SSO + 2FA. Tickets missing `requester_cidr` or `ttl` will be auto-rejected. See https://redwood.internal/access for fields.
rina.onboard: thanks! i'll open the INFRA ticket with ttl=8h and DM @tara-devex for the sandbox. appreciate the shortcut :pray:
